correctness.rationale: For the Moore determinant F=det(x_j^{q^i}) and B its first N−1 Frobenius rows, differentiating F in characteristic p leaves only the first row and gives ∂F/∂x_j=D_j^q exactly, not just set-theoretically. Moore-rank criterion identifies maximal-minor support I as union of all Fq-rational codimension-two flats, pure height two. Hilbert–Burch gives a CM height-two quotient, and generic transverse linear Jacobian terms make it generically reduced; R0+S1 imply I radical. Flat Frobenius of the regular polynomial ring preserves its primary intersection and exact resolution, giving J(F)=I^[q]=∩p_L^[q], length q² local rectangles, minimal shifts q(d+q^j) and global degree q² Gaussian [N choose 2]_q. Independently reconstructed symbolic derivatives over GF2 N=3,4 and finite degree identities for N=4,5/q=2,3; finite tests corroborate the general algebra.
